item.title: A loose wire on the containership Dali leads to hitting the Key Bridge
item.description: The US National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) said Tuesday that a single loose wire on the 984-foot-long containership Dali caused an electrical blackout that led to the giant vessel veering and contacting the nearby Francis Scott Key Bridge in Baltimore, which then collapsed, killing six highway workers.
